raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Lets AMD CI suites run on MI35x nodes scheduled through Spur, with a runner on the cluster's login node instead of an ARC pod on each GPU host. This PR adds a dispatch-only smoke-test workflow running the stage-a 1-GPU suite; wider suites can follow once the path is proven.

## Why

The `linux-mi35x-gpu-*` jobs assume an ARC pod. The GPU arch comes from a `linux-<arch>-gpu-N` hostname, and the persistent cache lives at `/home/runner/sglang-data`. A Spur node has neither. Without a fix, the scripts silently fall back to the mi30x image and to a container-local cache.

The DI nightly already runs on Spur through `launch_mi355x.sh`, but that launcher is built around multi-node disaggregation (RDMA, MORI, model staging). Single-node suites need none of that, so this adds a small launcher instead of extending it.

## Changes

- **`scripts/ci/amd/*`:** two optional overrides, both unset on ARC runners, so their behaviour is unchanged.
  - `AMD_CI_GPU_ARCH` is checked before the hostname.
  - `AMD_CI_CACHE_HOST` relocates the `/sgl-data` cache and turns the mount on by default.
- **`launch_amd_ci_mi35x.sh`** (runs on the runner) submits one whole-node job and streams its log into the step output. It handles the Spur behaviours found in #40113 and #41025:
  - jobs that are cancelled or held before they start are resubmitted;
  - one empty state reading is not taken as "finished";
  - a two-field time limit is rejected.
- **`amd_ci_job_mi35x.sh`** (runs on the node) runs the same steps as the ARC jobs: `ensure_vram_clear` → start container → install → `run_suite.py`.
  - The checkout is copied to node-local scratch first, because the root-run container writes into its bind mount and an NFS home with root squash refuses that.
  - The node is held `--exclusive`, because `ensure_vram_clear.sh` stops every GPU container on the host.
- **Runner environment:** cluster settings (`SLURM_PARTITION/ACCOUNT/QOS`, `CI_NODE_SCRATCH`) come from the runner's `.env`, the same way the DI nightly runner gets its cluster settings.

## Test plan

- Ran `launch_amd_ci_mi35x.sh --suite stage-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd --rocm-version rocm10` from a Spur login node against an MI355X node, the same command the workflow step runs.
  - `AMD_CI_GPU_ARCH` selected the mi35x image (`rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x-20261014`), and `/sgl-data` was mounted from node-local scratch.
  - The job's log streamed into the launcher output, and the launcher exited with the job's exit code.
  - The node's checkout copy and the `ci_sglang` container were removed afterwards.
- Suite result: 6 of 7 tests pass. `test_basic_sanity_eagle3.py` fails with a 401 on the gated `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`, because the manual run had no `HF_TOKEN`. The runner needs `HF_TOKEN` in its environment, as the ARC runners have.
- ARC path (both variables unset): [PR Test (AMD) run 38781829386](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38781829386), attempt 2, uses the hostname parse and `/home/runner/sglang-data` as before. 20 MI300 stage jobs pass, e.g. [stage-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38781829386/job/116593083497) and [stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (0)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38781829386/job/116599937121).
  - The one failure is `test_kda_kernels.py` in [stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd (2)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38781829386/job/116599936452). It fails the same way on `main` ([scheduled run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38734250959/job/116419462469)), so it isn't caused by this change.
  - The MI35x jobs are still queued.
- The workflow itself can't run until a runner with label `linux-sglang-mi35x-spur` is registered. Not yet verified.

---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #38781829328](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38781829328)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:x: [Run #38781829386](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38781829386)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->

+name: Test AMD MI35x (Spur)
+
+# Smoke test for MI35x nodes scheduled through Spur. The runner sits on the
+# cluster's login node and submits one single-node job per leg through
+# scripts/ci/slurm/launch_amd_ci_mi35x.sh, which runs the same container steps
+# as the linux-mi35x-gpu-* jobs in pr-test-amd.yml.
+#
+# Per-cluster settings (SLURM_PARTITION / SLURM_ACCOUNT / SLURM_QOS and the
+# node-local CI_NODE_SCRATCH) come from the runner's environment, as they do
+# for nightly-amd-mi355x-disagg.yml.
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      ref:
+        description: 'Branch, tag or SHA to test. Leave empty for the dispatching ref.'
+        required: false
+        default: ''
+      rocm_version:
+        description: 'ROCm image line'
+        required: false
+        default: 'rocm10'
+        type: choice
+        options: [rocm10, rocm724, rocm720]
+
+concurrency:
+  group: test-amd-mi35x-spur-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  stage-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x-spur:
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
+    runs-on: linux-sglang-mi35x-spur
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Run suite on a cluster node
+        timeout-minutes: 110
+        run: |
+          bash scripts/ci/slurm/launch_amd_ci_mi35x.sh \
+            --suite stage-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd \
+            --rocm-version "${{ inputs.rocm_version || 'rocm10' }}"
+
+      - name: Cancel cluster jobs on failure/cancel
+        if: failure() || cancelled()
+        continue-on-error: true
+        run: |
+          # Same prefix launch_amd_ci_mi35x.sh names its jobs with. %200j widens
+          # the name column; Spur's squeue does not accept --me.
+          PREFIX="amd-ci-${RUNNER_NAME}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-"

+          if [ -n "$JOBS" ]; then
+            echo "Cancelling: $JOBS"
+            scancel $JOBS
+          fi

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Body of one launch_amd_ci_mi35x.sh job; runs on the allocated MI35x node.
+#
+# Runs the same steps as a linux-mi35x-gpu-* job in pr-test-amd.yml. The node
+# is held whole (--exclusive), which ensure_vram_clear.sh relies on: it stops
+# every container on the host that holds a GPU.
+#
+# The checkout is copied to node-local scratch first. The CI container runs as
+# root and writes into its /sglang-checkout bind mount, which a root-squashed
+# NFS home would refuse.
+
+exec 2>&1   # Spur's batch --output captures stdout only
+set -euo pipefail
+
+: "${CI_SRC:?}" "${CI_SUITE:?}" "${CI_ROCM_VERSION:?}" "${CI_NODE_SCRATCH:?}" "${CI_EXIT_FILE:?}"
+JOB_ID="${SLURM_JOB_ID:-${SPUR_JOB_ID:-$$}}"
+WS="$CI_NODE_SCRATCH/ci-$JOB_ID"
+
+echo "[amd-ci-job] start on $(hostname) job=$JOB_ID suite=$CI_SUITE rocm=$CI_ROCM_VERSION"
+
+finish() {
+    local rc=$?
+    # Root-owned files from the container can only be removed from inside it.
+    docker exec ci_sglang bash -c 'rm -rf /sglang-checkout/* /sglang-checkout/.[!.]*' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    docker rm -f ci_sglang >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    rm -rf "$WS" 2>/dev/null || true
+    echo "$rc" > "$CI_EXIT_FILE"
+    echo "[amd-ci-job] exit $rc"
+}
+trap finish EXIT
+
+mkdir -p "$WS" "$CI_NODE_SCRATCH/sglang-data"
+cp -a "$CI_SRC/." "$WS/"
+cd "$WS"
+
+# The scripts read these instead of an ARC pod hostname and /home/runner.
+export GITHUB_WORKSPACE="$WS"
+export AMD_CI_GPU_ARCH=mi35x
+export AMD_CI_CACHE_HOST="$CI_NODE_SCRATCH/sglang-data"
+
+bash scripts/ci/amd/ensure_vram_clear.sh rocm
+bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_start_container.sh --rocm-version "$CI_ROCM_VERSION"
+bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_install_dependency.sh
+# shellcheck disable=SC2086  # CI_SUITE_ARGS is a list of run_suite.py flags
+bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w /sglang-checkout/test \
+    python3 run_suite.py --hw amd --suite "$CI_SUITE" $CI_SUITE_ARGS

@@ -0,0 +1,145 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Run one AMD CI suite on a single MI35x node scheduled through Spur.
+#
+# The GitHub runner lives on the cluster's login node. This script submits a
+# one-node, whole-node batch job running amd_ci_job_mi35x.sh -- the same
+# container steps a linux-mi35x-gpu-* ARC job runs in pr-test-amd.yml -- streams
+# the job's log into the step output, and exits with the suite's exit code.
+#
+# Spur behaviours handled here (see launch_mi355x.sh, #40113 and #41025):
+#   * batch output is not streamed back, so the job logs to shared storage and
+#     this script re-reads that file by offset each poll (`tail -F` misses
+#     appends made on another host over NFS);
+#   * a job can be cancelled or held (JobHoldMaxRequeue) before it starts, so a
+#     job that never started is resubmitted, up to SUBMIT_ATTEMPTS times;
+#   * the controller sometimes answers with an empty queue, so one missing
+#     state reading is not taken as "job finished";
+#   * a two-field time limit parses as HH:MM, so TIME_LIMIT must be HH:MM:SS.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   launch_amd_ci_mi35x.sh --suite NAME [--rocm-version rocm10] [-- run_suite.py args...]
+#
+# Required environment (set in the runner's .env, like the DI nightly runner):
+#   SLURM_PARTITION, SLURM_ACCOUNT, SLURM_QOS
+#   CI_NODE_SCRATCH  node-local directory for the checkout copy and the
+#                    persistent /sgl-data cache (models, pip, MIOpen)
+# Optional:
+#   SLURM_EXCLUDE    comma-separated nodes to keep the scheduler off
+#   TIME_LIMIT       default 01:30:00
+#   CI_SHARED_DIR    shared-storage dir for job logs, default $HOME/.amd_ci_spur
+#   SUBMIT_ATTEMPTS  default 3
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+SUITE=""
+ROCM_VERSION="rocm10"
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+    case "$1" in
+        --suite) SUITE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --rocm-version) ROCM_VERSION="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --) shift; break ;;
+        *) echo "ERROR: unknown argument '$1'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+    esac
+done
+SUITE_ARGS="$*"
+
+: "${SUITE:?--suite is required}"
+: "${SLURM_PARTITION:?set in the runner environment}"
+: "${SLURM_ACCOUNT:?set in the runner environment}"
+: "${SLURM_QOS:?set in the runner environment}"
+: "${CI_NODE_SCRATCH:?set in the runner environment}"
+: "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:?}"
+TIME_LIMIT="${TIME_LIMIT:-01:30:00}"
+SUBMIT_ATTEMPTS="${SUBMIT_ATTEMPTS:-3}"
+if [[ ! "$TIME_LIMIT" =~ ^([0-9]+-)?[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
+    echo "ERROR: TIME_LIMIT must be HH:MM:SS or D-HH:MM:SS (got '$TIME_LIMIT'); Spur reads '30:00' as 30 hours" >&2
+    exit 2
+fi
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+# The workflow's cleanup step cancels by this prefix, so keep the two in sync.
+JOB_PREFIX="amd-ci-${RUNNER_NAME:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-0}-"
+JOB_NAME="${JOB_PREFIX}${GITHUB_JOB:-job}"
+RUN_DIR="${CI_SHARED_DIR:-$HOME/.amd_ci_spur}/${JOB_NAME}"
+rm -rf "$RUN_DIR"
+mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
+
+# Read by amd_ci_job_mi35x.sh; sbatch exports the submitting environment.
+export CI_SRC="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" CI_SUITE="$SUITE" CI_SUITE_ARGS="$SUITE_ARGS"
+export CI_ROCM_VERSION="$ROCM_VERSION" CI_NODE_SCRATCH CI_EXIT_FILE="$RUN_DIR/exit_code"
+
+JOB_ID=""
+cleanup() {
+    if [[ -n "$JOB_ID" && ! -f "$CI_EXIT_FILE" ]]; then
+        echo "Cancelling cluster job $JOB_ID"
+        scancel "$JOB_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+trap 'exit 130' INT TERM
+
+LOG_OFFSET=0
+stream_log() {  # print what the job appended to $LOG since the last call
+    local size
+    size="$(stat -c %s "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
+    if (( size > LOG_OFFSET )); then
+        tail -c +"$((LOG_OFFSET + 1))" "$LOG" | head -c "$((size - LOG_OFFSET))"
+        LOG_OFFSET="$size"
+    fi
+}
+
+job_state() {  # "<STATE> <REASON>", or empty if the controller does not know the job
+    scontrol show job "$1" 2>/dev/null \
+        | awk '{for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i ~ /^(JobState|Reason)=/) {sub(/^[^=]*=/, "", $i); printf "%s ", $i}}'
+}
+
+for attempt in $(seq 1 "$SUBMIT_ATTEMPTS"); do
+    LOG="$RUN_DIR/attempt${attempt}.log"
+    : > "$LOG"
+    rm -f "$CI_EXIT_FILE"
+    SBATCH_ARGS=(-p "$SLURM_PARTITION" -A "$SLURM_ACCOUNT" -q "$SLURM_QOS"
+                 -N1 --exclusive -t "$TIME_LIMIT" -J "$JOB_NAME" --output "$LOG")
+    [[ -n "${SLURM_EXCLUDE:-}" ]] && SBATCH_ARGS+=(--exclude="$SLURM_EXCLUDE")
+    JOB_ID="$(sbatch --parsable "${SBATCH_ARGS[@]}" "$SCRIPT_DIR/amd_ci_job_mi35x.sh")"
+    JOB_ID="${JOB_ID%%;*}"
+    echo "Submitted job $JOB_ID (attempt $attempt/$SUBMIT_ATTEMPTS): suite=$SUITE rocm=$ROCM_VERSION"
+
+    LOG_OFFSET=0
+    misses=0
+    started=0
+    while true; do
+        sleep 15
+        stream_log
+        # The job writes its exit code last; COMPLETING can linger after that.
+        [[ -f "$CI_EXIT_FILE" ]] && break
+        read -r state reason <<< "$(job_state "$JOB_ID")" || true
+        case "${state:-}" in
+            PENDING)
+                misses=0
+                if [[ "${reason:-}" == JobHold* ]]; then
+                    echo "Job $JOB_ID held ($reason) before starting; cancelling"
+                    scancel "$JOB_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
+                    break
+                fi ;;
+            RUNNING|CONFIGURING|COMPLETING) misses=0; started=1 ;;
+            "") misses=$((misses + 1)); (( misses >= 4 )) && break ;;
+            *) break ;;
+        esac
+    done
+    sleep 5   # let the last log lines land on shared storage
+    stream_log
+
+    if [[ -f "$CI_EXIT_FILE" ]]; then
+        rc="$(cat "$CI_EXIT_FILE")"
+        echo "Job $JOB_ID finished with exit code $rc"
+        exit "$rc"
+    fi
+    if (( started )) || grep -q '^\[amd-ci-job\] start' "$LOG"; then
+        echo "ERROR: job $JOB_ID started but ended (${state:-gone} ${reason:-}) without writing an exit code" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    echo "Job $JOB_ID never started (${state:-gone} ${reason:-}); resubmitting"
+    JOB_ID=""
+done
+echo "ERROR: no job started after $SUBMIT_ATTEMPTS attempts" >&2
+exit 1
